audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 were hedged 'Skill' while whys[3] says the window 'stays Olaf-favored'; Level 6 was Olaf while whys[4] says neither side dominates; 2+ items was Olaf while whys[6] and late both say you outscale him.
audit.why: Packet chart is Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Shen — Olaf owns the whole laning phase on true damage, the ultimates cancel out at 6, and Shen's tank scaling takes the late game.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 6 set as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are right in shape: Olaf levels 1-5 on Reckless Swing, Ragnarok at 6, Sunfire at first item, Shen's two-item durability window. Cooldown numbers inside them corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three wrong numbers: Reckless Swing quoted at 'every 9 seconds' when it is 11/10/9/8/7; Shadow Dash called a 14-second cooldown at level 6 when rank 2 is 16s; Ragnarok called 'a 100-second cooldown at max rank' when 100s is rank 1 and max rank is 80s. Tough It Out was also credited with lifesteal.
audit.why: Reckless Swing (E, 325 range) is true damage — Ki Barrier does not reduce it and neither does armour, which is the core of the matchup. Ragnarok (R, 100/90/80s) makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so Shadow Dash is blank during it. The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with his missing health; Tough It Out is attack speed plus a shield.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns set to the kit values and the lifesteal attributed to his passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteractions feed claims Ragnarok can cancel Stand United.
audit.why: Ragnarok applies no crowd control in Riot's text — it grants resistances and disable immunity. The headline derives from the kit file's hardCC flag misfiring on the word 'disables'. Nothing about a Ragnarok interrupt was written. Undertow's 'grounding' flag is the same kind of artifact (the axe lands in the ground) and was likewise not used.
audit.corrected: No edit made; both recorded as unverified.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ragnarok's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his window: Reckless Swing (11s at rank 1) is true damage Ki Barrier cannot reduce, so farm safe and take no long trades.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy map, but Ragnarok blanks your taunt while he keeps attacking — neither side owns 6.

edits.before: Full kit Olaf with W lifesteal and E on a short cooldown sustains through your combo while dealing armor-proof true damage every 9 seconds — he wins every full trade here.
edits.after: Tough It Out shields him and Berserker Rage lifesteal grows as he drops, while Reckless Swing lands true damage every 11s at rank 1 — he wins every full trade here.

edits.before: At Level 6 the matchup becomes a map question. Ragnarok (R) makes him CC-immune for its full duration, which means your Shadow Dash is a blank on a 14-second cooldown if he pops it first — he will bait the E and then run you down. Track his Ragnarok timer obsessively: when it is on cooldown you have a real trade window, W up to block his auto burst, E-taunt into Q through the blade, and Ki Barrier absorbs the return. But if the local lane stays even, just sit on Stand United — the moment a teammate is in danger elsewhere you teleport globally and swing the game. Do not force local kills when your real power is the map.
edits.after: At Level 6 the matchup becomes a map question. Ragnarok (R) makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so your Shadow Dash is a blank on its 16-second rank-2 cooldown if he pops it first — he will bait the E and then run you down. Track his Ragnarok timer obsessively: when it is on cooldown you have a real trade window, W up to block his auto burst, E-taunt into Q through the blade, and Ki Barrier absorbs the return. But if the local lane stays even, just sit on Stand United — the moment a teammate is in danger elsewhere you teleport globally and swing the game. Do not force local kills when your real power is the map.

edits.before: Two completed items is your breakpoint. Sunfire Aegis into Hollow Radiance (or Heartsteel) means his Reckless Swing true damage is a smaller fraction of your total HP, your W-block is soaking meaningful burst, and your Q empowered trades actually out-damage his sustained brawling. He has no way to stop your taunt in teamfights without blowing Ragnarok, which has a 100-second cooldown at max rank — trade Stand United arrivals with his R windows and you control the game. Push side lanes, force objectives, and let your tank durability do what the early lane could not.
edits.after: Two completed items is your breakpoint. Sunfire Aegis into Hollow Radiance (or Heartsteel) means his Reckless Swing true damage is a smaller fraction of your total HP, your W-block is soaking meaningful burst, and your Q empowered trades actually out-damage his sustained brawling. He has no way to stop your taunt in teamfights without blowing Ragnarok, which is 100s at rank 1 and still 80s at max rank — trade Stand United arrivals with his R windows and you control the game. Push side lanes, force objectives, and let your tank durability do what the early lane could not.

notes: Two kit-file flag artifacts on Olaf were deliberately not written to the page: the hardCC flag on Ragnarok (Riot's text grants disable immunity, applies no CC, so it cannot interrupt Stand United despite the missingInteractions headline) and the grounding flag on Undertow (the axe 'lands in the ground'). Whether Spirit's Refuge blocks Reckless Swing is not derivable from Riot's text; the page's existing claim that it does not was left as-is rather than reinforced. Both packet suspectNames are false positives.
